title: Performance traces in four rules
purpose: Connect live metrics, traces, long tasks and yielding into one way of working.
sequence_reason: The rules build on each other: metrics show a problem, a trace locates it, and the long-task rule explains it.
summary: A recap. Live metrics show LCP, CLS and INP while you use the page. A recorded trace shows each task on the main thread. A task over 50 ms is a long task, and only the part past 50 ms is red. Yielding splits long work so input can run between pieces. Throttling is relative to your computer, so it is a guide, not a phone.
explanation: Use live metrics to spot a problem, a trace to find the long task, and yielding to keep tasks short.

learning_check.question: You see a high INP in live metrics. What do you do next?
learning_check.answer: Repeat the slow interaction while you record a trace, then look for long tasks in the Main track and the Interactions track.

scenes.heading: Same work, shorter wait
scenes.narration: At 4x in our example, one big task made a second click wait 135 milliseconds. Four yielding pieces cut it to 15.

scenes.heading: Throttling is a guide
scenes.narration: Throttling slows your own computer. It cannot copy a real phone, so check field data when you can.
